name: How Machines Work
summary: A guided tour of the machines around us, from levers and gears to engines, pumps, refrigerators and robots, explaining the working principle of each.

topics.name: Gears, belts and chains: trading speed for torque
Linkages and cams: converting rotary and linear motion
Bearings, shafts and couplings: supporting and transmitting rotation
Springs, dampers, clutches and brakes: storing, controlling and dissipating energy
Heat engines: how car engines and gas turbines turn fuel into work
Refrigerators, air conditioners and heat pumps
Hydraulic and pneumatic machines (jacks, excavators, air tools)
Electric motors and generators from a mechanical viewpoint
Integrated machines: clocks, bicycles, cars and teardown/dissection exercises
Robots and automated machines: sensors, actuators and control in outline
